bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
base=21b7ac80a6a8b2b030458e8426d1f94d6675c870
target=18d286432566f52684166c3e10fc7cd97bced342
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/editor-nav-18d2864
checkout="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
case "$(git -C "$checkout" remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 62;; esac
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
mkdir -p "$stage"
image="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
printf '%s\n' "$image" > "$stage/base-image"
git -C "$checkout" fetch --no-tags origin "$target"
test "$(git -C "$checkout" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
files="src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/sales/pgListings.mjs"
for f in $files;do
 for d in live base new patch;do mkdir -p "$stage/$d/$(dirname "$f")";done
 docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$f" "$stage/live/$f"
 git -C "$checkout" show "$base:$f" > "$stage/base/$f"
 git -C "$checkout" show "$target:$f" > "$stage/new/$f"
 if ! git merge-file -p --diff3 "$stage/live/$f" "$stage/base/$f" "$stage/new/$f" > "$stage/patch/$f";then
   echo "EDITOR_CONFLICT=$f"
 fi
done
python3 - "$stage" <<'PY'
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1])
bad=False
for p in (r/'patch').rglob('*.mjs'):
 s=p.read_text()
 for m in re.finditer(r'^<<<<<<< [^\n]*\n(.*?)^\|\|\|\|\|\|\| [^\n]*\n(.*?)^=======\n(.*?)^>>>>>>> [^\n]*\n',s,re.M|re.S):
  bad=True
  print('CONFLICT',p.relative_to(r/'patch'))
  for k,v in zip(('LIVE','BASE','NEW'),m.groups()):print(k+'\n'+v)
if bad:raise SystemExit(72)
PY
old=create-videobot:editor-nav-baseline-18d2864
new=create-videobot:editor-nav-candidate-18d2864
docker tag "$image" "$old"
{ printf 'FROM %s\nUSER root\n' "$old";for f in $files;do printf 'COPY --chown=node:node patch/%s /opt/videobot/%s\n' "$f" "$f";done;echo 'USER node'; } > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$new" "$stage" >/dev/null
for f in $files;do docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check "/opt/videobot/$f";done
echo EDITOR_NAV_CANDIDATE=PASS
